name: Avir Curve Hoop Earring
shortDescription: A rounded warm-toned hoop with a softly tapered profile.
description: Avir keeps the hoop simple and sculptural. Its smooth, rounded front catches the light across a warm-toned surface, while the profile narrows toward the opening. A quiet curve that sits close to the lobe.
design: Compact hoop with a rounded face and a tapered-looking profile.

name: Nirav Disc Stud
shortDescription: A small polished disc with an even warm-toned face.
description: Nirav is pared back to a single circular plane. Its smooth face reflects light softly, making the compact stud easy to wear as a subtle point of warmth.
design: Circular stud with a flat, unadorned front.

name: Rihan Framed Disc Stud
shortDescription: A dark round centre framed by warm geometric detail.
description: Rihan brings contrast to the stud silhouette. A dark circular centre sits within a warm-toned border, with a repeating angular motif visible along the edge. The detail appears gradually as the piece turns.
design: Round stud with a dark centre and a patterned outer frame.
finish: Smooth dark face against a reflective warm-toned border.

name: Kavi Matte Disc Stud
shortDescription: A clean dark disc with a softly matte appearance.
description: Kavi makes its statement through restraint. A plain, flat round face and dark, low-sheen finish give the stud a crisp outline without additional decoration.
design: Plain circular stud with a flat front.
finish: Dark matte-looking face with subtle edge definition.

name: Arka Petal Crescent Hoop
shortDescription: A warm crescent form with fine petal-like markings.
description: Arka draws the eye to a softly rounded crescent. Fine petal-like lines and a small floral accent interrupt the polished warm-toned surface, bringing character to a compact hoop silhouette.
design: Open-centre crescent hoop with fine decorative lines and a small floral-looking accent.
finish: Polished warm-toned surface with fine contrasting markings.

name: Ojas Ball-End Hoop
shortDescription: A pale-toned C curve finished with two rounded ends.
description: Ojas traces a compact, open curve. Two polished rounded ends give the simple pale-toned form its identity, while the space between them keeps the silhouette light.
design: Open C-shaped hoop with two rounded terminal details.

name: Samar Accent Hoop
shortDescription: A dark hoop with a line of small raised accents.
description: Samar adds texture to a compact hoop. A row of small rounded details follows its outer face, catching points of light against the dark surface while keeping the overall profile neat.
design: Compact hoop with a line of raised rounded details on its outer face.
finish: Dark reflective surface with brighter raised points.

name: Tejas Facet Hoop
shortDescription: A dark hoop shaped by small angular facets.
description: Tejas shifts the light across a series of compact planes. The faceted dark outer face gives a familiar hoop shape a textured, architectural edge.
design: Compact hoop with a series of angular facets along the visible outer face.
finish: Dark low-sheen surface with changing facet reflections.

name: Rion Ball Stud
shortDescription: A tiny polished sphere for a restrained point of warmth.
description: Rion is a single, smooth round detail. Its small scale and warm reflection make it one of the collection's quietest expressions, suited to a minimal everyday look.
design: Small spherical stud with a plain front.

name: Kiaan Flat Hoop
shortDescription: A compact dark hoop with a broad, plain face.
description: Kiaan gives the hoop a clean graphic outline. The broad flat-looking outer face carries a dark, softly reflective finish, with no surface pattern to distract from its shape.
design: Compact circular hoop with a broad plain outer face.
finish: Smooth dark surface with restrained reflections.

name: Ayaan Bevel Hoop
shortDescription: A warm-toned circular hoop with a broad bevelled face.
description: Ayaan balances a broad polished face with a clean angled edge. Its circular shape feels structured without losing the softness of a classic hoop.
design: Circular compact hoop with a broad front plane and bevelled edge.
finish: Polished warm-toned surface with a defined reflective bevel.

name: Devan Fine Hoop
shortDescription: A slender pale-toned hoop with an understated profile.
description: Devan draws a fine line around the lobe. The slim, smooth-looking circular form keeps the focus on proportion, making it an easy detail to wear alone.
design: Slim circular hoop with no visible decorative motif.

name: Neer Slim Hoop
shortDescription: A fine dark hoop with a rounded profile.
description: Neer keeps the hoop spare and fluid. Its narrow dark curve has a soft reflection along the edge, offering a quiet contrast against the skin.
design: Slim circular hoop with a smooth rounded-looking profile.
finish: Dark reflective surface with a clean outline.
